headline: Executive order creates a federal committee focused on wildland fire management policy.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a Wildland Fire Management Policy Committee within the federal government. The committee appears meant to shape or coordinate federal policy on managing wildfires on wild and natural lands. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the committee and what powers it has are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage public lands and fight wildfires
who_it_affects.how: They would likely take part in or follow the work of the new policy committee.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 14, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
